note: Yeter is a cord or bowstring (often of animal gut or sinew); 'withs' are willow twigs, a different material.

kjv: that I (Samson) may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes
mine: one act of vengeance for my (Samson's) two eyes
note: Neqam-achat mishtei einai is literally 'vengeance of one from my two eyes'; it can mean one single revenge for both eyes or revenge for (at least) one of his two eyes. The KJV's 'at once' smooths the phrase.
